scientific.integrity: The proof is symbolic. It independently reconstructs the recurrence from the source definitions and separates the proved method-level barrier from the unresolved global sharp-constant problem.
scientific.limitations: The result optimizes the threshold-surplus term only within finite proportional subdivisions using weighted convexity. It does not determine the asymptotic growth of the least global Poincare constant and does not treat non-proportional or unrelated proof schemes.

title: Optimality of equal bisection in the large-negative-\(\gamma\) Poincaré recurrence
